爱莎贝儿-151CM-L 粉肤 RAD007 横谷悠希子Yokotani Yukiko-陷入蜜罐里

唇瓣轻启时，带着奶香的气息，
咬一口便在舌尖化开，吮吸间喘息混着奶香，
甜腻又柔软，令人舍不得停。
身型：151CM-L 粉肤

She's like a freshly baked cream cake, so soft and fragrant you could be enveloped in it. Your fingers sink into her warm, delicate skin, like spreading melted butter.
When her lips part slightly, they carry a milky scent.
One bite and it melts on your tongue, the breath mingling with the milky aroma as you suck,
Sweet and soft, it's irresistible.
Body type: 151CM-L with Pink skin tone.
